comment: Worked out by hand. Five squares of 20 patched on the planes x = 0, x = 20, y = 0, y = 20 and z = 0 and stitched into an open box (the bottom's name kept); its opening at z = 20, picked at its edges' middles, patched by the plane and stitched on: a closed cube, solid, 20^3 = 8000. A 20 x 10 sheet at z = 0 (x 30..50, y 0..10, no volume) thickened 2 up (400) as a new body, 3 about itself (z -1.5..1.5, 600) as another, and 1 down (z -1..0) joined to the first: 600, z -1..2. The sheet stays.
